ForgeCMS 1.x creates its client from an options object with [`createForgeClient`](/v/1/reference/generated/create-forge-client) and [`ForgeClientOptions`](/v/1/reference/generated/forge-client-options). These links stay inside the 1.x reference.

:::code public-api.ts (1.x)

```ts
/** Creates a 1.x client from a project API key. */
export function createForgeClient(options: ForgeClientOptions): ForgeClient {
  return { getEntry: async () => (options.apiKey ? null : null) };
```
